references.context: For each pair X,Y, the hom-set of the opposite category is the reversed-direction hom-set of C.
If reversed arrows compose in C^op, their composite corresponds to the reversed order of the underlying C-composition.

references.disposition: The opposite category does not replace or dualize the objects themselves, only the morphisms and composition order.

review_rationale: Read opposite category with identical object collection, all hom-set directions reversed, and reversed composition preserving the categorical identity and associativity laws.
